feature: ADR-0159 ordered old-snapshot chord arbitration with fresh waiting eligibility and bounded work
initial_failures: Updated constructor API after source audit required two new test fixtures to drop obsolete eligibility arguments; corrected E0061 calls.

Source audit corrected initial freeze-before-wait design: upstream rechecks conditions/modifier manager before each lookahead manipulation. New advance uses one fresh view; only committed RuleSelection is frozen. ADR-0158 follow-up checklist corrected.
Manual budget review found charging repeated header search separately would starve budget=1; resumed eligibility check belongs to next receipt work step, added one-work regression.

windows.scope: Native Windows checks remain pending after prior automatic approval quota rejection; no new native attempt, bypass or valid capture/session.

limitations: ChordArbiter pins original first receipt Arc, searches ordered relevant Complex rules, permits only one window, waits earlier overlapping candidate before later shorter match/ordinary rule, and monotonically skips failed candidates. Original buffer/tail are moved, not replicated per candidate.

Every uncommitted advance rechecks current trusted condition/modifier view, as source requires; selected main conditions filter once and matched-empty consumes. Private RuleHeader creates frozen old-index/Arc/consumed RuleSelection; normal selector reuses same helper with existing behavior preserved.

Observe only queues validated owned input; preflight reject returns incoming unchanged. Resolution errors retain accepted inputs for consuming into_inputs. Match/ordinary/pass returns original events/tail and distinct current generation clock; future actual replay must refresh admission delivery at current stage clock without overwriting original history.

Default64 work budget and explicit1..64 yield preserve cursor/window/old Arc/tail. Resumed eligibility is part of next receipt step to avoid one-budget starvation. Individual predicate/action filtering retains existing bounded IR and is not a hard wall-clock guarantee.

19 tests cover ordinary priority, overlapping wait/match, interruption/early-Up fallback, original tail/order and separate generation clock, unknown/fresh eligibility/modifiers/action filters, old and new-peer Arc retention, boundary/frontier/provenance/abort/capacity/definition, one-work/long-list yield and invalid budgets.

This remains a pure arbitration component. Shared Complex group bindings/scopes/lease/branch/replay/repeat integration is still required; KW-SIM-001/UnsupportedSimultaneous stay. Native pointer/platform/hardware, GUI/packaging/driver and full objective remain incomplete.
abi: Pure shared Rust selection/owned-buffer arbitration; no new unsafe/FFI/dependencies/native packet layouts.
